svg.title: Blueberry ripeness dataset processing and validation pipeline
svg.desc: Six-stage pipeline: image acquisition, EXIF correction, mask preprocessing, semantic labelling, metadata and splits, and technical validation.
svg.text: Blueberry ripeness dataset processing and validation pipeline

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about greenhouse image acquisition with Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra')
sendPrompt('What does EXIF orientation correction and RGB-mask alignment involve?')
sendPrompt('How are JPEG masks converted to binary PNGs in mask preprocessing?')
sendPrompt('How are semantic label maps created with background, 1-5 classes, and 255 ignore values?')
sendPrompt('What is included in the metadata manifest, counts, and train/val/test splits?')
sendPrompt('What does technical validation check for integrity, quality, and baseline models?')
